description:
Given an arbitrary block of text and a brand of interest, return the list of competitor brand names mentioned (excluding the brand itself, and the AI assistants and search engines the text cites as sources, such as ChatGPT or Perplexity) and the sentiment toward the brand (positive | neutral | negative). Audits use the same extractor for their competitor lists.

Billing: free — uses no AuditAE credit and works at a zero balance.

Inputs: brand up to 200 characters; text up to 20,000 characters (send the relevant part of a longer answer).

Returns { competitors, sentiment, charged_cents: 0 }, plus error when the extraction couldn't run (competitors is then empty because nothing was read).

Example: { brand: "Linear", text: "Linear is a great choice, though many teams pick Asana or Jira for their wider integrations." }

brand.description: Brand of interest, as written in prose (up to 200 characters).

text.description: Text to analyze, e.g. an AI engine's answer, up to 20,000 characters.

name: extract_competitors_from_text
title: Extract competitors and sentiment from AI-generated text
